In Cobble ValleyWhat is this?
  • Enchanting is a discipline (Diamond Age): learn it from a quest or a master before the enchanting table or anvil will enchant for you.
  • You can only enchant gear you've mastered (100%). Renaming and the grindstone always work.
  • Enchanted loot shows "enchantments sleep until you master it". In v0.1 that's only a warning; v0.2 makes it real.
ItemAgeHow
Enchanting TableDiamond Agemust be learned (quest, teacher or practice)

BookshelfWood Agefree once its age is reached
GrindstoneStone Agefree once its age is reached

Any item: Item Lookup. Outside Cobble Valley (Our World, LAN worlds) none of this applies.
